name: Anxiety
description: Pattern characterized by persistent worry, tension, or physiological arousal.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. If feelings of anxiety become overwhelming or interfere with daily activities, consider consulting a healthcare professional.

solutions.title: Guided Breathing
solutions.purpose: Help the user slow and regulate their breathing during a period of anxiety.
instructions: Find a comfortable seated position with your back straight.
Inhale deeply through your nose for 4 seconds.
Hold your breath gently for 4 seconds.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 6 seconds.
Repeat this rhythmic cycle until the timer finishes.

solutions.title: Grounding Exercise
solutions.purpose: Help the user redirect attention toward the present environment.
instructions: Acknowledge 5 things you can see around you.
Acknowledge 4 things you can physically feel.
Acknowledge 3 things you can hear right now.
Acknowledge 2 things you can smell.
Acknowledge 1 thing you can taste.

solutions.title: Guided Meditation
solutions.purpose: Provide a short guided mindfulness/settling activity.
instructions: Sit comfortably and gently close your eyes.
Bring your awareness to the natural movement of your breath.
When your mind wanders, softly bring your focus back to breathing.
Allow thoughts to arise and pass without judgment.

solutions.title: Mind-Clearing Exercise
solutions.purpose: Give the user a short period to sit quietly, close their eyes, focus on breathing and allow thoughts to settle.
instructions: Sit in a quiet space and close your eyes if comfortable.
Take three slow, deep breaths, releasing tension with each exhale.
Visualize thoughts as clouds floating across a clear sky.
Rest quietly until the session concludes.

solutions.title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
solutions.purpose: Guide the user through relaxing different muscle groups.
instructions: Focus on your feet and toes: tense for 5 seconds, then release for 10.
Move to your calves and knees: tense for 5 seconds, then release.
Tense your thighs and abdomen, then completely let go.
Raise and squeeze your shoulders, then let them drop heavily.
Clench your hands into fists, then relax your fingers completely.
Notice the heavy, warm feeling of relaxation throughout your body.
